T2_crossing_occupancy_start.rationale: Provisional candidate: locomotive pilot passes front camera transverse lens plane / roadway occupancy line. Under Prerequisite R03, formal road boundary is uncertified; landmark reflects camera plane traversal.

T4_tail_clearance.rationale: Provisional candidate: rear buffer/diaphragm of the final rail vehicle (#3) clears crossing roadway line where pedestrian crowd immediately crosses. Under Prerequisite R03, formal departure roadway boundary is uncertified.

T_scene_clear.rationale: Unobservable: back camera recording terminates at 22.233s while receding train remains visible in frame.
